messages:
maya: Quick design sync — attaching the latest mock for the Credentials drawer when there are no keys and when a revoke/rotate fails. Need copy + a11y nits. tl;dr: empty states feel cold and the revoke failure surface is too scary. Thoughts?

devin: looks good overall. main thing: the primary CTA in empty state should be "Create API key" not "Get started" — explicit is better. also the icon feels too large on mobile.

sam: Agree on CTA wording. For revoke failure, current copy starts with 'Error:'. Can we soften to 'Unable to revoke key' and add reason if available? Eg: 'Unable to revoke key — network error. Try again.' 

karla: a11y: when the revoke fails we need an aria-live="assertive" toast so screen readers get notified. Right now the alert is inline and not announced. Also keyboard focus: after a failed revoke, focus should go to the inline error message or the retry button.

maya: Good call karla. I sketched an update: show inline message + dismissible toast. Focus trap only if modal opens — in drawer flow, shift focus to retry. I'll add aria-live and tab order notes.

devin: On tone — team wants less alarm-y language. Current copy: 'Revoke failed — critical error, contact support.' Too strong. Proposal: 'We couldn't revoke this key. Try again or contact support if the issue persists.' 

sam: +1. Also add microcopy under the revoke CTA: 'Active sessions may persist for a few minutes.' helps set expectations for downstream app owners.

maya: For empty state we debated two variants: 1) more product-led: 'Create an API key to start using the Redwood API' w/ example use cases. 2) Minimal: 'No API keys yet. Create one to get started.' Which do we prefer?

devin: I prefer variant 1 for new orgs (first time users) — it helps convert. But for small teams with many credentials, variant 2 is cleaner. Could we surface a context-aware variant? If user has no usage, show 1; otherwise show 2.

karla: If we do context-aware text, ensure the longer copy doesn't exceed 3 lines at mobile. Also ensure the CTA has a visible focus ring and 4.5:1 contrast.

sam: UX nit: The 'Show secret' button reveals token in a drawer and is currently a text link. Needs to be a button for keyboard accessibility and have aria-pressed when toggled.

maya: Noted. I'll change to a button component. Also thinking about permission matrix: when a user lacks 'create' perms we currently hide the CTA. Instead of hiding, show disabled CTA with tooltip 'You need admin permissions to create API keys' so it's discoverable. Thoughts?

devin: Show disabled + tooltip works well. Add link to docs in tooltip. Tooltip should be keyboard accessible (enter/space to open).

sam: Testing note: in the prototype test with 5 users, 2 thought 'Rotate key' looked like it changed the key name. Maybe rename to 'Create rotation' or 'Rotate credentials' ? Or add short hint 'Generate new secret, invalidates old secret.'

karla: For screen readers, include the hint in an offscreen description (aria-describedby) so it's read when focus moves to the rotate button.

maya: On the modal warning language for rotate — should we surface the exact consequences? e.g., 'Rotating will immediately invalidate the previous secret; any running services using it may fail until updated.' Keep it short.

devin: Yes, and add a 'Read more' link to rotate best practices (docs). On the CTA we use 'Rotate key' (primary) and 'Cancel' (secondary). Ordering: primary on right in our pattern? Our current console uses primary on left for destructive flows — what do we want?

sam: For destructive or high-impact ops, primary on left has been confusing in tests. We should follow the platform pattern: primary on right, secondary on left. Consistency > special-case.

maya: We'll normalize to primary-right. I'll update the component library.

luis-bot: deploy-bot: design-proposal/cred-drawer-v3 pushed to staging at sha=b7a3f2. Preview: https://staging.redwood.example/preview/cred-drawer-v3

devin: thx @luis-bot. I'll review the live and add comments around spacing and mobile truncation.

maya: Action items: 1) I'll update copy variants and add aria-live to toast. 2) karla to add keyboard/a11y acceptance criteria. 3) devex to flip primary button placement and update docs. 4) sam to add microcopy about session expiry and rotation hint. Anyone want to add acceptance examples?

sam: Acceptance: screen reader reads revoke failure toast immediately; after revoke failure, tab lands on retry; disabled CTA has keyboard-focusable tooltip; rotate modal shows consequence line and docs link.

karla: Also add unit test for contrast and focus ring presence at 1024x768 and mobile widths.

maya: Great — I'll push updated mock + copy by EOD. Thanks all :rocket:
